rationale: A has the stronger art direction: a giant gradient 'Halo' wordmark behind the speaker, a shift from dark to a warm cream materials section with tactile fabric/oak/aluminium arches, an exploded wireframe of the cylinder, and a closing oversized wordmark, plus more expressive hover (custom cursor ring, amber fill with glow). B's entrance is cleaner (masked line reveal of 'Sound, held in a ring of light' with the product present by ~280 ms), whereas A flashes its full layout at 80 ms, blanks, then slowly rebuilds and only settles near 2 s. B's sticky labelled exploded view and room-plan interaction are well executed but its uniformly dark palette and subtler hovers feel less distinctive; both phone layouts are clean with no clipping.
